name: ab-test-sample-size-calculator
description: Calculates the minimum number of visitors needed per variant for a statistically valid A/B test. Uses baseline CVR, minimum detectable effect (MDE), significance level, and statistical power.

baselineCVR.description: Current conversion rate as a percentage (e.g. 2.5)

mde.description: Minimum detectable effect as a relative percentage improvement (e.g. 15 for 15% relative lift)

significance.description: Statistical significance level as a percentage (default 95)
